facts.text: Sir Alfred lies broken and incapacitated but not destroyed in the Barrow Mound, and may recover to threaten the Free Goblin Society members who plan to settle its upper rooms behind a wall across the stairs, or anyone who goes back down.
Why does the undead knight Sir Alfred, whom Brother Dirk regards as holy, roam the Barrow Mound?
